title: ICS 213 from IMT Operations: IP-1 Depopulation Complete and Recovery Look-Ahead

fields.incidentName: Calder County HPAI - IP-1 Ridgeline Farm
fields.subject: IP-1 depopulation status and recovery look-ahead
fields.message:
1. Barn 4 depopulation completed at 0802. All four IP-1 barns are done, 12 minutes past the 24-hour goal of 0750. The final bird count and the number of samples taken are pending the carcass tally. Please log them when received.
2. Next steps: Prairie Gold names its cleaning and disinfection contractor, APHIS inspects each step, and then environmental testing and a fallow period follow. The cooperative estimates 8 to 12 weeks to restocking, which puts it between mid-December and mid-January.
3. The control area stays in place until the Board and APHIS release it. Expect checkpoints for weeks, not days.
4. MDH note: depopulation crew members who entered barn 4 today restart their 10-day monitoring clock today (10/21). Their monitoring now runs through 10/31.

approvedBy.name: Dr. M. Lindqvist
approvedBy.position: USDA APHIS VS Area Veterinarian in Charge

instructorNote: This end-game inject moves the room from response to a recovery that will take weeks. Check that OPS logs the 12-minute miss plainly, and that the Sheriff starts a checkpoint staffing plan for weeks of coverage. PROD should confirm the C&D contractor, and CPH should move monitoring end dates to 10/31. The Director should cite Annex K section 9: checkpoints come down within 24 hours of the Board's release, and the after-action meeting happens within 30 days.
